inherited_methods.method: full-component alteration charged only by raw event overlap

inherited_methods.lost_information: the shared integer, normalized cardinality defect, and whether subtracting two relations creates a new petal-only bad support
inherited_methods.consequence: the top-band star has exponential raw dependency degree although one shared deletion repairs the entire cluster

inherited_methods.method: one packed circuit followed by representatives selected inside that circuit
inherited_methods.loss_step: localize every circuit meeting the packed member to its intersection with the packed support
inherited_methods.lost_information: cheap petal vertices and deletions reusable across several interacting clusters
inherited_methods.consequence: the audited core-with-private-satellites family forces Omega(log N) internal representatives and destroys the required o(log N) loss

inherited_methods.method: largest-prime ownership based on top fibre and bounded residue summaries
inherited_methods.loss_step: discard the exact signed cofactor ratio and the lower-prime incidence component after assigning the largest prime
inherited_methods.lost_information: arbitrary coprime numerator and denominator support propagated through long prime-labelled paths
inherited_methods.consequence: no bounded fan, alphabet, depth, or local congestion estimate can imply o(log N) owner load

inherited_methods.method: local recursive potentials such as token count, active degree, forest rank, or peeled-prime depth
inherited_methods.loss_step: measure a single transition without charging the same residue as it moves through the rest of the connected component
inherited_methods.lost_information: global telescoping cancellation, component reuse, and scale at which the transferred residue finally terminates
inherited_methods.consequence: RR.1 carries an unchanged two-token obstruction through arbitrarily many increasing prime edges

inherited_methods.loss_step: freeze decisions below a prime cutoff without budgeting completions by future larger primes
inherited_methods.lost_information: the revision set and its upper-density cost across all later scales
inherited_methods.consequence: RR.2 can complete arbitrary lower data into a new minimal bad relation using one later top prime

inherited_methods.method: finite transversals selected independently for each N
inherited_methods.loss_step: optimize each H_N separately and then pass to an unspecified subsequence
inherited_methods.lost_information: pointwise compatibility of admissions and convergence of deletion densities between cutoffs
inherited_methods.consequence: even a proved tau(H_N)=o(N) would not by itself construct the required infinite set with an actual natural-density limit

required_new_information: The exact signed relation kernel of every failure cluster, including normalized cardinality defect under circuit subtraction.
A cross-cluster charging object that may delete petal vertices and reuse one repair across several packed circuits.
A full top-prime/cofactor-residue flow state together with a genuinely simpler dual certificate for aggregate owner congestion.
A multiscale potential whose decrease telescopes over an entire connected propagation rather than one peeled prime.
A revision reserve with summable scale costs or zero upper density, sufficient to prove pointwise stabilization and an actual density limit.
An all-parameter obstruction whenever one of these global claims fails; a repeat of RR.1/RR.2 against an already closed local claim is non-progress.
